name: Weekly product funnel watcher
why: Finds the funnel step that lost the most each week and one experiment to run, the same loop as the funnel drop-off skill.

name: Set up product tracking and build a retention dashboard
why: Goes from an event plan to a retention grid and dashboard, matching the tracking plan and retention cohort skills.

name: Find where new users leave and prove the fix works
why: Finds the biggest leak and plans a test of the fix, the core of this role's funnel and test plan work.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: Catches broken events and double counts each month, the check the tracking plan workflow runs after release.

name: Cohort funnel reader
why: Reads results by join date to see where each group drops off, the cohort side of funnel and retention work.

name: Customer onboarding keeper
why: Tracks where each week's new customers stall in their first 30 days, an onboarding funnel and cohort view.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Shows where subscribers leave and whether last month's fix worked, the retention analyst's monthly question.

name: Subscription churn audit
why: A deeper churn review for subscription businesses, useful alongside the retention cohort skill.

name: Repeat order bottleneck finder
why: Finds where first-time buyers fail to come back, the repeat purchase view for online shops.

name: First-use gap checker
why: Looks at the first-use experience where activation drop-offs usually start.

name: Experiment readout desk
why: Checks a test plan before launch and reads the result after, the companion to the test plan skill.

name: A/B test traffic checker
why: Checks whether a test split matches the plan, the sample ratio check this kit insists on.

name: Test result trust checker
why: Says whether to trust a finished test and gives the lift as a range before anyone ships.
